title: Sunrise Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Sunrise is a 1.00 bedroom, 1.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Sunrise | Newly Renovated Seaside Guest Cottage 194 Feet from the BeachSunrise is a newly renovated and expanded one-bedroom guest home in Seaside, Florida, ideally located on charming East Ruskin Street just 194 feet from the beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion. This prime Seaside location is also just one block from downtown, making it easy to walk to the beach, Central Square, Seaside’s iconic shops, restaurants, and local events. Beautifully redesigned with new furnishings and thoughtful coastal details, Sunrise offers a stylish and comfortable retreat for couples or small families looking for a walkable Seaside vacation.Walk 194 Feet to the Beach from SunriseGuests arrive along a classic sandy Seaside footpath leading to the home and its spacious open-air front deck. The large, fenced-in wooden deck provides a private outdoor setting with Adirondack seating for two, creating an inviting spot for morning coffee, an afternoon break, or an evening drink while listening to the nearby Gulf waves. Guests also have access to a shared charcoal grill and an outdoor rain shower, making beach days even more convenient.Renovated King Bedroom and Spa-Inspired BathroomThe first level features a newly renovated and expanded king bedroom with all-new designer furnishings. Custom built-in storage surrounds the bed and includes integrated reading lights, while a mounted flat-screen TV with YouTube TV provides easy entertainment. The completely renovated bathroom features a marble vanity and a spacious glass-enclosed walk-in shower with both a rain showerhead and handheld shower wand, creating a fresh, spa-inspired space to relax after a day at the beach.Brand-New Designer Kitchen and Open Living SpaceUpstairs, the newly expanded main living level features a bright, open-concept design with a brand-new designer kitchen. The kitchen includes quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a two-burner electric cooktop, full-size refrigerator with ice maker, microwave with convection functionality, and countertop dishwasher. The kitchen is stocked with new dishware, cookware, and essential kitchen supplies for preparing meals at the home. Please note: the kitchen does not include a full-size oven.The adjacent living area features all-new designer furnishings and a comfortable queen Tempur-Pedic sleeper sofa, providing additional sleeping space. A large mounted flat-screen TV creates a comfortable place to unwind, while a charming bistro-style dining area for two offers a dedicated spot for meals. A Juliet balcony overlooks the sandy Seaside footpath below.Prime Seaside Location Near Shops, Restaurants and Central SquareSunrise combines the convenience of a 194-foot walk to the beach with easy access to downtown Seaside. From the home, guests can walk to Central Square and more than 40 shops and restaurants, as well as Seaside’s popular events and entertainment. There is no need to rely on a car to enjoy many of the best things to do in Seaside.The Perfect Seaside Getaway for Couples and Small FamiliesWith its complete renovation, king bedroom, new designer furnishings, private fenced deck, prime East Ruskin Street location, and beach access just 194 feet away, Sunrise offers a fresh take on the classic Seaside guest home. Spend the day on the beach, explore downtown, dine at Seaside’s restaurants, or simply relax on the deck before returning to a beautifully redesigned home filled with modern comfort and coastal charm.Need more space, check out the main home, A Beautiful Day.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES556 square feet1-minute walk (194 feet) to beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion, the largest private residential beach on 30AOutdoor dining deckOutdoor showerShared charcoal grillPeacock Alley Linen Partner — fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided1 parking pass issued (a golf cart is considered a car; golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited—special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit)No pets allowedSTR23-002135
